p: spreadeth a net for his feet: He who gives ear to the flatterer is in danger as the bird is before the fowler.
snare: He is always ready to fall into the snare that he lays for others.
a foolish man: He can hear no admonition no matter how it is spoken.
Where there is no vision: Where there are not faithful ministers of the word of God.
servant will not be corrected by: He who is of a servile and rebellious nature.
snare: He who fears man more than God falls into a snare and is destroyed.
judgment cometh from the LORD: He does not need to flatter the ruler, for what God has appointed will come to him.
